# PE utilization, 16x16 array (256 PEs), generated by scripts/pe_utilization.py
# utilization = M*K*N / (cycles * 256)

## 1. Measured on the board (docs/reports/gemmtest_board.txt, first run)
#  job  = the CYCLES register (START to idle); call = DMA in + job + DMA out,
#  core = the same GEMM on the core alone (RV32I, shift-add multiply)
     shape    MACs    job  model  job util    call  call util     core

## 2. Model: job_cycles() (= the RTL's CYCLES at ARRAY_CDC = 0, every test)
#  per tile: ROWS cycles of weight load + 1 swap + M rows + LATENCY + 2 drain,
#  LATENCY = 23; tiles do not overlap. Shapes past a buffer are refused.
         shape tiles  cycles   util
      16x16x16     1      61  26.2%
      64x16x16     1     109  58.7%
     128x16x16     1     173  74.0%
     256x16x16     1     301  85.0%
      64x64x64    16    1699  60.3%
     128x64x32     8    1363  75.1%
     256x64x16     4    1195  85.7%
    128x128x32    16    2723  75.2%
      17x17x17     4     239   8.0%
     100x50x30     8    1139  51.4%
      256x1x16     1     301   5.3%
      1x1024x1    64    2755   0.1%

# Bound: with K, N multiples of 16, utilization = M / (M + 42) per tile
# (less the 3 shape-check cycles); the buffers cap M at 256 (C lines / N tiles), so at most 85.9%.
# With ARRAY_CDC = 1 at equal clocks a tile costs 2*SYNC_STAGES + 1 cycles more
# (measurements.md, "Array clock domain: model cost").
